facts.fact: The WHO Country Cooperation Strategy states that Seychelles collects routine data through various units and that data capture is mainly paper-based; it gives no date for the statement, so the document's published date (January 2025, month inferred) is used.

The WHO Country Cooperation Strategy says Seychelles needs to develop a digital health policy and an e-Health strategic plan and to establish a consolidated architecture; dated by the document's published date (January 2025).
